q: 把视觉搜索的核心处理管线按查询时的先后排序：
q_en: Order the core visual-search pipeline as it runs at query time:
scenario: 用户上传一张照片，要在 10 亿图索引上 <200ms 返回相似/可购买结果。
scenario_en: A user uploads a photo and must get similar/shoppable results in under 200ms over a billion-image index.
steps: ANN 近似最近邻检索，从十亿向量里快速取回 top-k 候选
把上传图编码成 embedding 向量
在小得多的 top-k 上做多模态重排(视觉+文本信号)
全程受 <200ms 延迟预算约束，超时要降级
why: 管线：先把查询图编码成 embedding→用 ANN 在十亿级向量里近似检索 top-k→在小候选集上多模态重排→整条链受 <200ms 预算约束。框架决策会级联到每个下游选择。
why_en: Encode the query image to an embedding, retrieve top-k via ANN over a billion vectors, re-rank the small candidate set with multi-modal signals, all under a sub-200ms budget.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  U[上传图] --> E[生成 embedding] --> A["ANN 检索 top-k"] --> R[多模态重排] --> O[结果]

termDefinitions.meaning: 把图像编码成的定长数值向量，语义相近的图在向量空间里距离近。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding is a fixed-length numeric vector encoding an image so semantically similar images are close in vector space.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻检索：牺牲少量召回换数量级提速，在十亿向量里可行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor) search trades a little recall for orders-of-magnitude speedup, making billion-vector retrieval feasible.

scenario: 接到'用户传照片，看相似结果或可购买商品'的题，你还没画任何框图。
scenario_en: Given 'user uploads a photo, sees similar results or shoppable products,' before you draw any box.
q: 开局第一步最该先做什么？
q_en: What should you pin down first?
why: 先明确并说清你解的是 image-to-image(感知相似)还是 image-to-product(语义商品匹配)，以及为什么。混淆二者是最常见的候选人错误——框架决策会级联到索引语料、训练信号、指标、失败模式每一处。
why_en: First state which formulation you are solving — image-to-image (perceptual similarity) or image-to-product (semantic product matching) — and why, because conflating them is the most common mistake and cascades into every downstream choice.
tradeoff: 先定问题表述再画框(下游一致) vs 直接堆模型(表述含糊、指标打架)
whenOtherWins: 若产品需求已在题面写死(如纯电商'找同款购买')，可略过表述选择、直接按 image-to-product 展开，但仍要一句话点明。
options: 先定表述：图搜图还是图搜商品，并说明理由
先选定 CNN 还是 ViT 编码器，模型定了再谈需求
先把 ANN 索引结构(HNSW/IVF)选好，检索才是系统核心
先估算 GPU 数量和推理成本，产能定了再设计架构
options_en: First state the formulation — image-to-image or image-to-product — and why.
First pick the encoder (CNN vs ViT); once the model is set, discuss requirements.
First choose the ANN index structure (HNSW/IVF), since retrieval is the core of the system.
First estimate GPU count and inference cost; once capacity is set, design the architecture.
optionExplanations: 对；表述决定了你到底要匹配什么，后面每个组件才有验收标准，不然团队各说各话。
错；编码器是实现细节，表述没定就选模型，等于不知道要匹配什么就先造匹配器。
错；索引结构服务于检索目标，目标(感知相似还是商品匹配)未定，选 HNSW/IVF 没有依据。
错；成本估算是产能准备，回答不了'我们到底在匹配什么'这个框架问题。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the formulation defines what you are matching, which is what gives every downstream component an acceptance criterion.
Wrong — the encoder is an implementation detail; picking a model before the formulation is building a matcher before knowing what to match.
Wrong — the index structure serves the retrieval goal; with the goal (perceptual vs product) unset, choosing HNSW/IVF has no basis.
Wrong — cost estimation is capacity prep and cannot answer the framing question of what you are actually matching.

termDefinitions.meaning: 以感知相似为目标：找视觉上像的图(如 Pinterest Lens 探索)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Image-to-image targets perceptual similarity: find visually alike images, like Pinterest Lens explore.

termDefinitions.meaning: 以语义商品匹配为目标：把查询图对到目录里的具体可购买商品(如 Amazon StyleSnap)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Image-to-product targets semantic product matching: map the query image to a specific shoppable catalog item, like Amazon StyleSnap.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻检索：不扫全部向量，牺牲少量召回换数量级提速。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN stands for approximate nearest neighbor search: it skips scanning every vector, trading a little recall for orders-of-magnitude speedup.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种分层图 ANN 索引，在图上贪心跳转找近邻，快但内存占用高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW is a hierarchical graph ANN index that greedily hops across the graph to find neighbors — fast but memory-hungry.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把向量聚成簇、查询时只搜相关簇的 ANN 索引，常配 PQ 压缩省内存。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IVF is an ANN index that clusters vectors and searches only the relevant clusters, often paired with PQ compression to save memory.

scenario: 同一张'红色皮包'照片，图搜图和图搜商品要的东西不一样，训练信号和索引语料也不同。
scenario_en: For the same red-leather-bag photo, image-to-image and image-to-product want different things, with different training signals and index corpora.
q: image-to-image 与 image-to-product 在目标、语料、训练信号上有何区别？
q_en: How do image-to-image and image-to-product differ in objective, corpus, and training signal?
why: 图搜图=感知相似，语料是网络爬图，用视觉对比损失，指标是视觉相关性 precision@k；图搜商品=语义商品匹配，语料是结构化目录(带价格/库存)，用跨模态对比损失训练图-商品对，指标是购买转化/命中率。二者失败模式也不同。
why_en: Image-to-image is perceptual similarity over web-crawled images with a visual contrastive loss and precision@k, while image-to-product is semantic matching over a structured catalog with cross-modal contrastive loss and purchase conversion.
tradeoff: 感知相似(视觉对比损失/网络图) vs 语义商品匹配(跨模态对比损失/目录)
options: 两者只是索引大小不同，目标、语料、训练信号、指标和失败模式其实完全一样
图搜图用跨模态损失，图搜商品用纯视觉损失，两者训练信号正好相反
图搜图=感知相似+网络图+视觉损失；图搜商品=语义匹配+目录+跨模态损失
图搜商品不建目录索引，查询时直接对全网商品图做实时暴力比对来匹配
options_en: They differ only in index size — objective, corpus, training signal, metrics and failure modes are actually all identical.
Image-to-image uses cross-modal loss and image-to-product uses pure visual loss — the training signals are exactly reversed.
Image-to-image is perceptual similarity, web images, visual loss; image-to-product is semantic matching, catalog, cross-modal loss.
Image-to-product skips building a catalog index; at query time it just brute-force compares against all web product images to find a match.
optionExplanations: 错；恰恰相反，目标不同导致语料、训练信号和指标全都不同，这正是不能混淆的原因。
说反了；图搜商品才需要跨模态对齐(图对商品文本)，图搜图用视觉对比损失。
对；每一维都由表述决定，这张对照表就是'混淆表述会级联出错'的具体展开。
错；十亿级商品实时全比对不可行，必须建结构化目录索引，这条既错又违背延迟预算。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — on the contrary, different objectives make the corpus, training signal, and metrics all differ, which is exactly why they must not be conflated.
Backwards — image-to-product is the one needing cross-modal alignment (image to product text), while image-to-image uses a visual contrastive loss.
Correct — every dimension follows from the formulation, and this table is the concrete unfolding of how conflating formulations cascades into errors.
Wrong — real-time full comparison over a billion products is infeasible; a structured catalog index is required, so this is both wrong and against the latency budget.

termDefinitions.term: cross-modal contrastive loss / 跨模态对比损失
termDefinitions.meaning: 在图-商品(或图-文)成对样本上训练，把匹配对拉近、非匹配对推远，对齐两种模态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cross-modal contrastive loss trains on paired image-product (or image-text) samples, pulling matches together and pushing non-matches apart to align the two modalities.

termDefinitions.meaning: 返回前 k 个结果里相关的比例，衡量图搜图的视觉相关性质量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Precision@k is the fraction of the top-k results that are relevant, measuring image-to-image visual relevance quality.

scenario: 上线后指标显示：视觉相似结果的 precision@10 很高，但购买转化几乎为零。
scenario_en: In production, precision@10 on visually similar results is high, but purchase conversion is near zero.
q: 这个指标组合说明系统哪里错了？
q_en: What does this metric combination reveal is wrong?
why: 高感知精度+零转化=用错了表述：系统按 image-to-image(视觉相似)优化，但业务目标其实需要 image-to-product(语义商品匹配)。视觉上像不等于是用户想买的那件具体商品，症状就是像但不成单。
why_en: High perceptual precision with zero conversion is the telltale sign of the wrong formulation: it was optimized for image-to-image but the objective needs image-to-product matching.
options: 编码器太弱，换更大的视觉模型就能同时提升 precision 和购买转化
ANN 召回不够，加大 top-k 把更多候选放进来，转化就能拉起来
按图搜图优化了，业务要的却是图搜商品匹配
延迟太高导致用户流失，把端到端优化到 <200ms 转化自然回升
options_en: The encoder is too weak; a bigger vision model would raise both precision and purchase conversion.
ANN recall is insufficient; raising top-k to admit more candidates would lift conversion.
It was optimized for image-to-image, but the business needs image-to-product matching.
Latency is too high causing churn; optimizing end-to-end to sub-200ms would restore conversion.
optionExplanations: 错；precision@10 已经很高说明视觉匹配没问题，换大模型只会更像，转化仍上不去。
错；召回更多视觉相似图只会加深'像但不对款'的问题，不解决表述错配。
对；症状(高精度零转化)直指表述用错，要引入语义商品匹配而非继续优化视觉相似。
错；延迟高会普遍降体验，但不会造出'精度高却零转化'这种表述性错配的特征信号。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — high precision@10 shows visual matching is fine; a bigger model only makes results more alike while conversion stays flat.
Wrong — recalling more visually similar images deepens the 'similar but wrong item' problem and does not fix the formulation mismatch.
Correct — the symptom (high precision, zero conversion) points squarely at the wrong formulation, needing semantic product matching, not more visual similarity.
Wrong — high latency hurts experience broadly but does not produce the signature of a formulation mismatch, high precision with zero conversion.

termDefinitions.meaning: 真实用户照片(光照/背景/遮挡多变)与干净目录图之间的分布差异，图搜商品必须跨越它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The domain gap is the distribution difference between real user photos (varied lighting, backgrounds, occlusion) and clean catalog images that image-to-product must bridge.

scenario: 线上 recall 尚可，但 CTR 偏低：用户看到结果却很少点击。
scenario_en: Online recall is acceptable but CTR is low: users see results yet rarely click.
q: recall 可接受但 CTR 低，最该加哪个设计杠杆？
q_en: With acceptable recall but low CTR, which design lever should you add?
why: recall 够说明候选检回来了，CTR 低是排序不吸引人→这是重排问题：加第二阶段重排器，用多模态信号(文本元数据、用户历史)把更相关的往前排。CTR 衡量结果的吸引力/相关性。
why_en: Acceptable recall means candidates are retrieved, so low CTR is a ranking problem: add a second-stage re-ranker using multi-modal signals like text metadata and user history.
tradeoff: 加重排器(修排序、提 CTR) vs 动检索(recall 已够，动它无益)
whenOtherWins: 若 recall 本就不足(候选里根本没有相关项)，先修检索/召回，加重排器也排不出不存在的好结果。
options: 加第二阶段重排器，用文本元数据、用户历史等信号重排
放宽 ANN 阈值召回更多候选，用候选数量弥补点击率
换更大的图像编码器，让 embedding 向量算得更准
把延迟预算缩短到 <100ms，让结果出得更快一些
options_en: Add a second-stage re-ranker that reorders using text metadata and user history.
Loosen the ANN threshold to recall more candidates, compensating click-through with volume.
Swap in a bigger image encoder so the embedding vectors are more accurate.
Shorten the latency budget to sub-100ms so results appear a bit faster.
optionExplanations: 对；recall 已够、点击不行=排序问题，重排器用多模态信号重新排，是对症的杠杆。
错；召回更多不解决'排得不吸引人'，只会把更多平庸结果堆上来，CTR 还是低。
错；embedding 更准提升的是检索，recall 本就可接受，问题在排序不在编码。
错；更快出结果不改变结果本身是否相关，CTR 低是相关性排序问题不是速度问题。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — with recall fine but clicks poor, it is a ranking problem, and a re-ranker with multi-modal signals is the on-target lever.
Wrong — recalling more does not fix 'ranked unattractively' and just piles on mediocre results, keeping CTR low.
Wrong — better embeddings improve retrieval, but recall is already acceptable; the problem is ranking, not encoding.
Wrong — faster results do not change whether results are relevant; low CTR is a relevance-ranking issue, not speed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结果被点击的比例，衡量结果的吸引力与相关性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CTR (Click-Through Rate) is the fraction of results clicked, measuring their attractiveness and relevance.

termDefinitions.term: second-stage re-ranker / 第二阶段重排器
termDefinitions.meaning: 在检索出的 top-k 上再打分排序的模型，融合视觉+文本+用户信号提升相关性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A second-stage re-ranker rescores the retrieved top-k, fusing visual, text, and user signals to improve relevance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻检索：不扫全部向量，牺牲少量召回换数量级提速。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN stands for approximate nearest neighbor search: it skips scanning every vector, trading a little recall for orders-of-magnitude speedup.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把图像或文本编码成的定长浮点向量，距离近代表语义或视觉相近。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding is a fixed-length float vector encoding an image or text, where nearby vectors mean semantically or visually similar items.

termDefinitions.meaning: 该被检回的相关结果里，实际被候选集覆盖到的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall is the share of the truly relevant results that the candidate set actually retrieved.

scenario: CTR 很高(用户爱点)，但购买转化率低：点得多、买得少。
scenario_en: CTR is high (users click a lot) but purchase conversion is low: many clicks, few buys.
q: 高 CTR 但低转化，该加哪个上游模块？
q_en: With high CTR but low conversion, which upstream module should you add?
why: 高 CTR 说明结果吸引点击，但低转化=相关性对不上真实购买意图。在上游加意图分类模块，把查询路由到正确的索引(如'找同款买'路由到商品索引，'找灵感'路由到探索索引)，消除意图错配。
why_en: High CTR with low conversion is a relevance-to-intent mismatch, so add an upstream intent-classification module that routes the query to the correct index.
tradeoff: 上游意图分类(对齐意图、修转化) vs 继续调重排(只提点击、不解意图错配)
whenOtherWins: 若 CTR 本身也低，问题在排序相关性而非意图路由，此时先加重排器；意图分类解决的是'点得多买得少'的意图错配。
options: 继续加大重排器权重，把更吸引点击的结果排更前
在上游加意图分类模块，把查询路由到正确的索引，消除相关性-意图错配
放宽阈值降低 zero-result rate，让更多结果出现
换更快的 ANN，让转化路径响应更快
options_en: Keep increasing the re-ranker weight to push more click-attractive results to the top.
Add an upstream intent-classification module that routes the query to the correct index, removing the relevance-to-intent mismatch.
Loosen thresholds to lower zero-result rate so more results appear.
Switch to a faster ANN so the conversion path responds quicker.
optionExplanations: 错；CTR 已高，继续优化点击只会加剧'点得多买得少'，转化根因是意图错配不是点击不足。
对；意图分类把查询导向对的索引(购买 vs 探索)，让结果匹配真实意图，直击低转化根因。
错；zero-result 不是这里的瓶颈，放阈值反而引入更多不相关结果，转化更差。
错；更快的 ANN 不改变结果是否匹配购买意图，速度救不了意图错配。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — CTR is already high, and optimizing clicks further worsens 'many clicks, few buys'; the root cause is intent mismatch, not too few clicks.
Correct — intent classification routes the query to the right index (buy vs explore) so results match true intent, hitting the low-conversion root cause.
Wrong — zero-result is not the bottleneck here, and loosening thresholds injects more irrelevant results, hurting conversion.
Wrong — a faster ANN does not change whether results match purchase intent; speed cannot fix an intent mismatch.

termDefinitions.term: purchase conversion rate / 购买转化率
termDefinitions.meaning: 产生交易的会话比例，视觉商品搜索的最终营收指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Purchase conversion rate is the fraction of sessions with a transaction, the ultimate revenue metric for visual product search.

termDefinitions.meaning: 上游判断用户查询意图(购买/探索/审核)并路由到对应索引的模块。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Intent classification is an upstream module that infers the query intent (buy/explore/moderate) and routes it to the matching index.

scenario: zero-result rate 偏高：大量查询没有任何结果越过阈值返回。
scenario_en: Zero-result rate is high: many queries return nothing above threshold.
q: zero-result rate 高，通常怎么修？
q_en: How do you typically fix a high zero-result rate?
why: 高 zero-result 多是 embedding 覆盖有缺口或过滤太激进→加 ANN 回退层：主索引未命中就退到更宽松的阈值再检一次。它衡量的是索引覆盖与泛化。
why_en: A high zero-result rate usually means embedding coverage gaps or over-aggressive filtering, so add ANN fallback tiers that re-search a looser index or threshold when the primary index misses.
tradeoff: 加回退层(提覆盖、降 zero-result) vs 收紧阈值(高精度但更多空结果)
whenOtherWins: 若高 zero-result 是安全/NSFW 过滤误杀合法内容造成的，应先调过滤器阈值，而不是加回退层把不该出的也放出来。
options: 加 ANN 回退层：主索引未命中就退到更宽松索引/阈值再检一次，兜住覆盖
直接返回随机热门结果兜底，保证界面每次查询都有东西可显示，掩盖空结果
提高相似度阈值，让结果更精准，zero-result 自然下降
关闭意图分类这层过滤，让更多候选进入检索环节，误以为过滤层是空结果的根因
options_en: Add ANN fallback tiers: on a primary miss, re-search a looser index/threshold to cover the query.
Return random popular results as a fallback so the query always shows something on screen — masking rather than fixing the empty result.
Raise the similarity threshold for more precise results, which lowers zero-result.
Turn off the intent-classification filter so more candidates enter retrieval, mistakenly treating that layer as the root cause of empty results.
optionExplanations: 对；回退层在主索引失手时用更宽松的检索兜底，直接补覆盖缺口，是对 zero-result 的对症修法。
错；返回随机热门是掩盖空结果不是修覆盖，会毁掉相关性和信任。
说反了；提高阈值会让更多查询过不了线，zero-result 只会更高不是更低。
错；意图分类不是 zero-result 的根因，关掉它反而可能把查询导错索引，覆盖更差。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — fallback tiers catch primary misses with a looser search, directly filling the coverage gap, the on-target fix for zero-result.
Wrong — returning random popular items masks empty results rather than fixing coverage and destroys relevance and trust.
Backwards — raising the threshold makes more queries fail the bar, so zero-result rises, not falls.
Wrong — intent classification is not the root cause of zero-result; turning it off may misroute queries to the wrong index, worsening coverage.

termDefinitions.meaning: 没有任何结果越过阈值的查询比例，衡量索引覆盖与 embedding 泛化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Zero-result rate is the fraction of queries with no result above threshold, measuring index coverage and embedding generalization.

termDefinitions.term: ANN fallback tiers / ANN 回退层
termDefinitions.meaning: 主索引未命中时依次退到更宽松索引/阈值再检的多级兜底策略。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN fallback tiers are staged back-offs that re-search progressively looser indexes/thresholds when the primary index misses.

scenario: 工程师想同时把 zero-result rate、precision、CTR 都做到最好，调一个阈值。
scenario_en: An engineer wants to simultaneously maximize zero-result rate, precision, and CTR by tuning one threshold.
q: 为什么这些指标会互相拉扯，调一个阈值救不了全部？
q_en: Why do these metrics pull against each other so one threshold cannot optimize all?
why: 阈值有内在张力：放松阈值→更多查询有结果，zero-result 降，但混进不相关项，precision/CTR 降；收紧阈值→结果更准，但更多查询变空，zero-result 升。所以是权衡不是同时最优，要按指标层级取舍。
why_en: Relaxing the threshold lowers zero-result but admits irrelevant items and cuts precision/CTR, while tightening does the reverse, so it is a trade-off, not a simultaneous optimum.
tradeoff: 放松阈值(降 zero-result 但降精度) vs 收紧阈值(升精度但升 zero-result)
options: 只要 embedding 训练得够好，一个阈值就能让三个指标同时最优，没有张力
放松阈值降 zero-result 却伤 precision/CTR；收紧则相反
三个指标其实同向变化，调高阈值会让 precision、CTR、覆盖一起变好
阈值只影响检索延迟，不影响 precision、CTR 这些质量指标
options_en: With a well-trained enough embedding, one threshold optimizes all three metrics at once — there is no tension.
Relaxing the threshold lowers zero-result but hurts precision and CTR, and tightening does the reverse.
The three metrics actually move together — raising the threshold improves precision, CTR, and coverage all at once.
The threshold only affects retrieval latency, not quality metrics like precision and CTR.
optionExplanations: 错；再好的 embedding 也改变不了阈值的方向性张力，放宽和收紧对覆盖与精度的作用天然相反。
对；阈值一头连覆盖一头连精度，动一边必然牺牲另一边，所以要靠指标层级决定取舍点。
说反了；调高阈值虽然升 precision，但会让更多查询跌出阈值、覆盖下降，zero-result 和 precision/CTR 是反向不是同向。
错；阈值直接决定哪些结果算数，深刻影响覆盖与精度，不只是延迟。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — no matter how well-trained the embedding, it cannot remove the threshold's directional tension; relaxing and tightening inherently act oppositely on coverage and precision.
Correct — the threshold links coverage on one side and precision on the other, so moving one sacrifices the other, and a metric hierarchy sets the operating point.
Backwards — raising the threshold does lift precision, but pushes more queries below it, lowering coverage; zero-result and precision/CTR move oppositely, not together.
Wrong — the threshold decides which results count and deeply affects coverage and precision, not just latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 结果被接受所需的最低相似度分；放松增覆盖降精度，收紧反之。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The similarity threshold is the minimum score a result needs to be accepted; loosening raises coverage and lowers precision, tightening does the opposite.

q: 把视觉搜索的指标层级从'门槛'到'终极目标'排序：
q_en: Order the visual-search metric hierarchy from gating to ultimate objective:
scenario: L5+ 要把三个业务指标讲成一个层级，而不是并列可互换。
scenario_en: At L5+ you present the three business metrics as a hierarchy, not interchangeable equals.
steps: CTR：结果有没有用(吸引点击、相关)
zero-result rate：功能能不能用(有没有结果返回)
购买转化率：有没有达成业务目标(产生交易)
why: 层级：zero-result rate 先把关功能可用性(连结果都没有就无从谈起)→CTR 衡量结果是否有用→购买转化衡量是否达成业务目标。CTR/转化又能反哺重排器训练形成正循环，但前提是上游检索先surface出足够候选。
why_en: Zero-result rate gates whether the feature works at all, CTR measures usefulness, and purchase conversion measures the business objective, forming a hierarchy.
diagram:
flowchart TB Z["zero-result rate
功能可用性(门槛)"] --> C["CTR
结果有用性"] --> P["购买转化
业务目标"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 把指标按'先决门槛→有用性→终极目标'分层，而非并列互换，指导优化优先级。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A metric hierarchy layers metrics as gating prerequisite, usefulness, and ultimate objective rather than interchangeable equals, guiding optimization priority.

scenario: 要在 10 亿张图上做检索，有人提议直接暴力精确比对查询向量和每一个索引向量。
scenario_en: For retrieval over a billion images, someone proposes brute-force exact comparison of the query vector against every index vector.
q: 十亿级向量的规模，对检索方案意味着什么？
q_en: What does billion-vector scale imply for the retrieval approach?
why: 1B × 256 维 float32 ≈ 1TB 原始向量(10^9 × 256 × 4 字节)。每次查询暴力扫十亿向量在 <200ms 内不可行→必须用 ANN(HNSW/IVF)，牺牲少量召回换数量级提速。这个量级直接否掉暴力精确检索。
why_en: 1B × 256-dim float32 is about 1TB of raw vectors, and brute-force scanning a billion per query cannot fit sub-200ms, so ANN (HNSW/IVF) is required.
options: 十亿向量规模不算大，现代 CPU 暴力精确检索也能在 <200ms 内完成，无需 ANN
1B×256维 float32≈1TB，暴力扫装不进 <200ms→必须上 ANN
只要用 PCA 把向量降到 8 维再暴力检索，延迟就能达标，不用专门 ANN 索引
规模问题靠加机器线性扩展就行，单次查询延迟并不会受影响
options_en: A billion vectors isn't that large; modern CPUs can even do brute-force exact search under 200ms, so no ANN is needed.
1B x 256-dim float32 is about 1TB, and a brute-force scan cannot fit sub-200ms, so ANN is required.
Just use PCA to reduce vectors to 8 dimensions and brute force meets the latency budget, no special ANN index needed.
Scale is solved by adding machines linearly; single-query latency is not affected.
optionExplanations: 错；十亿向量单查询暴力比对是十亿次距离计算，现代 CPU 也扛不住，远超 200ms，量级上就不可行。
对；把维度×字节×条数一乘就知道是 TB 级，暴力检索延迟爆表，只能上 ANN 近似。
错；砍到 8 维会严重损失表达力、召回崩塌，PCA 降维换不来暴力检索所需的速度，是拿相关性换速度的错误取舍。
错；加机器能分片但单次查询仍要在分片里检索，延迟不会因加机器自动达标。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — brute-forcing a billion vectors per query is a billion distance computations that even modern CPUs cannot finish under 200ms, infeasible at this scale.
Correct — multiplying dims × bytes × count gives terabytes, brute-force latency blows up, so ANN approximation is the only way.
Wrong — cutting to 8 dims cripples expressiveness and collapses recall; PCA reduction still cannot buy brute force the speed it needs, a wrong trade of relevance for speed.
Wrong — adding machines shards data but each query still searches within shards; latency does not auto-comply by adding machines.

termDefinitions.term: brute-force exact search / 暴力精确检索
termDefinitions.meaning: 把查询向量和每一个索引向量都算一遍距离取最近，精确但在十亿级不可行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Brute-force exact search computes the distance to every index vector for the exact nearest neighbors, precise but infeasible at billion scale.

scenario: 决定十亿级向量索引结构，主要候选是 HNSW 和 IVF(常配 PQ)。
scenario_en: Choosing the billion-scale vector index structure, the main candidates are HNSW and IVF (often with PQ).
q: HNSW 和 IVF 作为 ANN 索引，共同点和取舍是什么？
q_en: As ANN indexes, what do HNSW and IVF share and trade off?
why: 两者都是 ANN，牺牲少量召回换数量级提速。HNSW=分层图上贪心跳转，快但吃内存；IVF=聚簇只搜相关簇，配 PQ 省内存但要调 nprobe。
why_en: Both are ANN indexes trading a little recall for orders-of-magnitude speed: HNSW hops a hierarchical graph and is fast but memory-hungry, while IVF searches only relevant clusters and pairs with PQ to save memory at the cost of tuning nprobe.
tradeoff: HNSW(图检索快但吃内存) vs IVF+PQ(省内存、超大规模但要调 nprobe)
options: 两者都做精确检索，区别只是底层实现语言和索引库版本不同，不影响召回
都是 ANN；HNSW 快但吃内存，IVF+PQ 省内存要调 nprobe
HNSW 只是暴力检索换了个名字，真正做近似检索的 ANN 索引只有 IVF 一种
IVF 检索一定比 HNSW 更准，因为它每次都会搜索全部簇
options_en: Both do exact search; they differ only in implementation language and index-library version, with no effect on recall.
Both are ANN; HNSW is fast but memory-hungry, IVF+PQ saves memory but needs nprobe tuning.
HNSW is just brute force under a different name; IVF is the only real ANN index doing approximate search.
IVF is always more accurate than HNSW because it searches every cluster each time.
optionExplanations: 错；两者都是近似(ANN)不是精确，区别在数据结构与内存-召回取舍，不是语言或库版本，这些差异恰恰会影响召回。
对；同为 ANN 但走不同路：图 vs 倒排聚簇，内存与调参代价不同，按预算和目标选。
错；HNSW 是图结构上的近似检索(ANN)，不是暴力检索换个名字，这条把概念搞反了。
错；IVF 恰恰只搜相关的少数簇(nprobe 控制)以提速，搜所有簇就退化成暴力了。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — both are approximate (ANN), not exact; they differ in data structure and memory-recall trade-off, not language or library version, and those differences do affect recall.
Correct — both are ANN but take different routes, graph vs inverted clusters, with different memory and tuning costs, chosen by budget and target.
Wrong — HNSW is a graph-based approximate search (ANN), not brute force under another name; this reverses the concept.
Wrong — IVF deliberately searches only a few relevant clusters (controlled by nprobe) for speed; searching all clusters degenerates to brute force.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分层可导航小世界图：在近邻图上贪心跳转找最近邻，检索快、内存占用较高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) is a layered proximity graph where greedy hops find nearest neighbors, fast but memory-heavy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 倒排文件索引：把向量聚成簇，查询只搜最相关的若干簇(nprobe)，常配 PQ 压缩。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IVF (Inverted File Index) clusters vectors and searches only the most relevant clusters (nprobe) per query, often with PQ compression.

termDefinitions.meaning: 乘积量化：把向量切段各自量化压缩，大幅省内存、加速距离近似计算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PQ (Product Quantization) splits vectors into sub-segments and quantizes each, sharply cutting memory and speeding approximate distance computation.

q: 按 <200ms 预算，把各阶段耗时从大到小排(哪个是主导成本)：
q_en: Order the sub-200ms budget stages from largest to smallest cost:
scenario: 要把 <200ms 预算分配到管线各阶段，先认清哪个阶段最吃时间。
scenario_en: Allocating the sub-200ms budget across pipeline stages, first see which stage dominates.
steps: 重排：10–30ms(多模态打分、业务规则过滤)
embedding 推理：10–50ms GPU(通常是主导成本，ResNet/ViT/CLIP)
ANN 检索：1–10ms(HNSW 遍历 / IVF+PQ 查表)
why: embedding 推理 10–50ms 通常是主导成本→重排 10–30ms→ANN 检索 1–10ms 最快。剩余给上传+预处理(缩放/归一化)+网络序列化。认清 embedding 是大头，优化才有的放矢(如换更小编码器/批处理)。
why_en: Embedding inference (10–50ms) usually dominates, then re-ranking (10–30ms), then ANN retrieval (1–10ms) which is fastest, with the remainder for upload/preprocess/network.
diagram:
flowchart LR E["embedding 10-50ms
主导"] --> R["重排 10-30ms"] --> A["ANN 1-10ms"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 端到端总延迟上限(此处 <200ms)拆分到各阶段的分配，指导每段该压到多少。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A latency budget is the end-to-end latency ceiling (here <200ms) allocated across stages, guiding how much each must be squeezed to.

scenario: 团队想升级/重训 embedding 模型以提升召回，索引里已有十亿条旧向量。
scenario_en: The team wants to retrain/upgrade the embedding model to improve recall, with a billion old vectors already indexed.
q: 重训 embedding 模型会带来什么运营风险，怎么缓解？
q_en: What operational risk does retraining the embedding model create, and how to mitigate?
why: embedding drift：新模型的查询向量和旧索引向量落在不同空间、不可比→必须对十亿级语料全量重建索引(耗时数天)。缓解：embedding 版本化、并行构建新索引、蓝绿部署切换，避免在线中断。
why_en: Embedding drift makes new query vectors incompatible with old indexed vectors (spaces misalign), forcing a multi-day full re-index, mitigated by versioning, parallel builds, and blue-green deployment.
tradeoff: 升级 embedding(提召回) vs 全量重建十亿索引(耗时数天、需蓝绿切换)
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Q[新查询向量] -. 空间不对齐 .-> O[旧索引向量]
  N[并行建新索引 v2] --> BG{蓝绿切换}
  O --> BG
  BG --> S[无缝上线]
options: 重训后新旧向量自动兼容，直接替换模型即可，无需重建索引
只有查询侧受影响，索引不用动，新旧向量混用也没有问题
新查询向量与旧索引不同空间→须全量重建；靠版本化+蓝绿切换
重训只影响精度不影响索引，索引结构与模型版本互相独立
options_en: After retraining, new and old vectors are automatically compatible, so just swap the model with no re-index.
Only the query side is affected; the index stays put and mixing new and old vectors is fine.
New query vectors land in a different space from the old index, forcing a full rebuild, mitigated by versioning and blue-green cutover.
Retraining only affects accuracy, not the index; index structure is independent of model version.
optionExplanations: 错；不同模型产出不同向量空间，新查询向量对旧索引不可比，混用会检索错乱。
错；查询侧变了索引侧不变=两套空间硬比，相似度失真，混用恰恰是问题本身。
对；空间错配逼出全量重建，蓝绿+版本化+并行建库让重建在后台完成再无缝切换，避免停服。
错；索引里存的正是某版模型的向量，模型换代必然要求索引跟着重建，二者强相关。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — different models produce different vector spaces; new query vectors are incomparable to the old index and mixing causes garbled retrieval.
Wrong — changing the query side but not the index means two spaces compared head-on, distorting similarity; mixing is exactly the problem.
Correct — the space mismatch forces a full rebuild, and blue-green plus versioning plus parallel builds let it finish in the background then switch seamlessly, avoiding downtime.
Wrong — the index stores a specific model version's vectors, so a model change necessarily requires rebuilding the index; they are tightly coupled.

termDefinitions.meaning: 重训 embedding 模型使向量空间改变，旧索引向量与新查询向量不再可比。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding drift is when retraining the embedding model shifts the vector space so old indexed vectors no longer align with new query vectors.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在后台建好新索引(绿)后与旧索引(蓝)瞬时切换，实现无停机上线与快速回退。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Blue-green deployment builds the new index (green) alongside the old (blue) and switches instantly, giving zero-downtime cutover and fast rollback.

scenario: 面试要给'十亿级索引'一个可信的行业锚点，说明这不是纸上谈兵。
scenario_en: You want a credible industry anchor for 'billion-scale index' to show it is not hypothetical.
q: '十亿级图像索引'的现实量级锚点是什么，说明什么？
q_en: What is a real-world anchor for a billion-image index, and what does it establish?
why: Pinterest 索引 50 亿+ 图像，是十亿级检索的真实行业锚点(不是推导值)。它说明该规模是生产常态，直接迫使采用 ANN 与十亿级索引架构，而非把'十亿'当纸面假设。
why_en: Pinterest indexes 5B+ images, a real industry anchor establishing that billion-scale is a production norm that forces ANN and billion-scale index architecture.
options: 行业里图像搜索最大规模也就百万级，做十亿级索引纯属过度设计
Pinterest 索引 50 亿+ 图像，十亿级是生产常态
十亿只是理论上限，实际生产系统的图像索引从来不会超过十万级规模
图像数量和索引架构选型无关，无论多少张图都能用同一套暴力检索方案
options_en: The largest image search deployments in industry are only million-scale; building a billion-scale index is pure over-engineering.
Pinterest indexes 5B+ images, showing billion-scale is a production norm.
A billion is only a theoretical ceiling; real production image indexes never actually exceed hundreds of thousands.
Image count is unrelated to index architecture choice; any count can use the same brute-force search approach.
optionExplanations: 错；主流图像搜索早已十亿级，把它当过度设计严重低估了现实规模。
对；50 亿+ 的真实锚点把'十亿'从假设变成生产常态，直接决定必须用 ANN 与专门索引架构。
错；恰恰相反，生产系统常态就在十亿级以上，十万级规模只是玩具量级。
错；数量级直接决定能否暴力检索，十亿级下暴力不可行，架构必须随规模变。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — mainstream image search is already billion-scale, so calling it over-engineering badly underestimates reality.
Correct — the 5B+ anchor turns 'a billion' from hypothesis into a production norm that directly mandates ANN and a dedicated index architecture.
Wrong — on the contrary, production systems routinely run at billion-scale or beyond; hundreds of thousands is toy scale.
Wrong — the order of magnitude directly decides whether brute force is possible; at a billion it is infeasible, so architecture must scale with size.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对十亿量级向量建索引以支持检索，Pinterest 达 50 亿+，是行业真实规模。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Billion-scale indexing builds an index over a billion-order vectors for retrieval; Pinterest reaches 5B+, a real industry scale.

scenario: Staff+ 面试里，要把视觉搜索定位成公司级能力，而不是一个孤立功能。
scenario_en: In a Staff+ interview, you position visual search as a company-level capability, not an isolated feature.
q: Staff+ 视角下，视觉搜索该被框成什么？
q_en: At Staff+, how should visual search be framed?
why: 框成平台能力：一套共享 embedding 基础设施服务发现/购物/审核，目录索引+网络索引并行查询。指标从离线 recall@k→在线 CTR→营收串成层级。
why_en: Frame it as a platform capability: one shared embedding infrastructure serving discovery, shopping and moderation, with catalog and web indexes queried in parallel and metrics laddering from offline recall at k to online CTR to revenue.
tradeoff: 平台能力(共享 embedding、多索引、指标层级) vs 单点功能(只做一条查询流)
whenOtherWins: 在早期 MVP、只需验证单一图搜图场景时，做成单一功能更快落地；平台化在多场景复用和规模化时才回本。
options: 框成一个独立小功能：只覆盖图搜图一条查询流，跑通 demo 就算完成
框成平台能力：共享 embedding 基础设施+多索引+指标层级
框成一次性项目：上线交付后不再演化，不需要做版本化或多索引扩展
框成纯模型问题：把所有精力都投入训练一个更大更准的图像编码器
options_en: Frame it as a standalone mini-feature: cover only the image-to-image query flow, done once the demo runs.
Frame it as a platform capability: shared embedding infra, multiple indexes, and a metric hierarchy.
Frame it as a one-off project: no evolution after launch and delivery, no versioning or multi-index expansion needed.
Frame it as a pure model problem: pour all effort into training a bigger, more accurate image encoder.
optionExplanations: 错；只覆盖一条查询流是 L4 视角，跑通 demo 不代表捕捉了共享基础设施与多场景复用的平台价值。
对；共享 embedding+多索引并行+recall→CTR→营收的层级，正是从功能上升到平台的 Staff+ 整合。
错；embedding drift 与业务演化决定它必须持续版本化和多索引扩展，一次性项目框法站不住。
错；本课明确说多数人过度准备模型层、准备不足 scoping，纯模型框法正踩这个坑。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — covering only one query flow is the L4 view; getting a demo running does not capture the platform value of shared infra and multi-scenario reuse.
Correct — shared embeddings plus parallel multi-index plus a recall-to-CTR-to-revenue hierarchy is exactly the Staff+ integration from feature to platform.
Wrong — embedding drift and business evolution require ongoing versioning and multi-index expansion, so a one-off framing does not hold.
Wrong — the lesson explicitly says most people over-prepare the model layer and under-prepare scoping, and a pure-model framing walks into that trap.

termDefinitions.meaning: 并行查询多个专用索引(如商品目录索引+网络图索引)再融合结果，服务不同意图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A multi-index architecture queries multiple specialized indexes in parallel (e.g. catalog and web) and fuses results to serve different intents.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把某功能建成可被多场景(发现/购物/审核)复用的共享基础设施，而非孤立特性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A platform capability builds a function as shared infrastructure reusable across scenarios (discovery/shopping/moderation) rather than an isolated feature.

scenario: 团队想用点击/购买数据反哺重排器训练，形成越用越准的正循环。
scenario_en: The team wants click/purchase data to feed re-ranker training, forming a virtuous cycle that improves with use.
q: 这个'正循环'成立的前提是什么？
q_en: What is the precondition for this virtuous cycle to hold?
why: CTR/转化数据能反哺重排器训练形成正循环，但前提是上游检索先 surface 出足够多的相关候选——没有好候选，就没有有意义的点击信号可学，循环空转。所以检索召回是这个飞轮的入口闸门。
why_en: CTR/conversion data can train the re-ranker in a virtuous cycle only if upstream retrieval first surfaces enough relevant candidates, otherwise there is no meaningful click signal to learn from.
options: 只要有足够用户流量，循环就自动成立，和检索质量无关
前提是上游检索先 surface 出足够多的相关候选，否则飞轮空转
前提是把端到端延迟压到接近 0，用户才会产生足够点击
前提是关闭 zero-result 兜底，只留最相关的那一个结果
options_en: As long as there is enough user traffic the cycle is self-sustaining, regardless of retrieval quality.
The precondition is that upstream retrieval surfaces enough relevant candidates, else the flywheel spins empty.
The precondition is driving end-to-end latency near zero so users generate enough clicks.
The precondition is disabling the zero-result fallback and keeping only the single most relevant result.
optionExplanations: 错；有流量但候选都不相关，点击数据也是噪声，学不出更好的排序，循环无从建立。
对；重排器只能在检索给的候选里重排，候选里没有好结果，反哺信号就无价值，检索召回是入口闸门。
错；延迟为 0 不可能也非关键,循环的瓶颈是候选相关性不是速度。
错；只留一个结果反而扼杀探索与点击多样性，采不到足够训练信号，与正循环相悖。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — with traffic but irrelevant candidates, click data is noise that cannot teach better ranking, so the cycle never forms.
Correct — the re-ranker can only reorder the candidates retrieval gives it; without good ones the feedback signal is worthless, making retrieval recall the entry gate.
Wrong — zero latency is impossible and not the point; the cycle's bottleneck is candidate relevance, not speed.
Wrong — keeping a single result kills exploration and click diversity, starving training signal, against the virtuous cycle.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线上点击/购买数据反哺重排器训练、模型再改善体验的自强化循环，需上游召回足够候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A virtuous cycle feeds online click/purchase data back into re-ranker training so the model improves the experience, requiring upstream recall to surface enough candidates.

scenario: 图搜商品要把用户随手拍的真实照片(杂乱光照/背景/遮挡)对到干净的目录商品图。
scenario_en: Image-to-product must map a user's casual real photo (messy lighting, background, occlusion) to a clean catalog product image.
q: 为什么图搜商品必须跨越'域差'，不跨越会怎样？
q_en: Why must image-to-product bridge a domain gap, and what happens if it does not?
why: 真实照片和目录图分布不同(光照/背景/遮挡差异)=域差。若 embedding 只在干净目录图上学，遇到真实照片就对不准，检回视觉相近但错款的结果。要用真实-目录成对数据做跨模态/域适应训练来跨越它。
why_en: Real photos and catalog images have different distributions (lighting, background, occlusion), so an embedding trained only on clean catalog images misaligns on real photos and returns similar-looking wrong products.
tradeoff: 用真实-目录成对数据训练(跨域但贵) vs 只用干净目录图(便宜但真实照片对不准)
options: 域差并不存在，只要分辨率一致，真实照片和目录图对模型没区别
真实照片与目录图分布不同，只学目录图会在真实照片上检回错款
跨越域差只需把用户照片转成黑白，消除颜色分布差异即可
域差只影响延迟不影响准确率，加一层压缩预处理就能解决
options_en: There is no domain gap; as long as resolution matches, real photos and catalog images look the same to the model.
Real photos and catalog images have different distributions, so training only on catalog images returns wrong products for real photos.
Bridging the gap just needs converting user photos to grayscale to remove color distribution differences.
The domain gap only affects latency, not accuracy, and one compression preprocessing layer solves it.
optionExplanations: 错；分辨率一致解决不了光照/背景/遮挡带来的分布差异，域差是真实存在的核心难点。
对；分布不一致会让 embedding 空间对不齐，必须用真实-目录成对数据训练来弥合，否则错款频出。
错；转黑白丢信息更糟，域差是多因素分布差异，不是单一颜色问题。
错；域差是准确率(匹配对不对)问题，不是延迟问题，预处理压缩救不了。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — matching resolution does not fix the distribution difference from lighting/background/occlusion; the domain gap is a real core difficulty.
Correct — a distribution mismatch misaligns the embedding space, so real-photo-to-catalog paired training is needed to bridge it, or wrong products keep appearing.
Wrong — grayscale discards information and worsens it; the gap is a multi-factor distribution difference, not a single color issue.
Wrong — the domain gap is an accuracy (correct-match) problem, not latency, so preprocessing compression cannot solve it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让模型在源域(干净目录图)学到的能力迁移到目标域(真实用户照片)的训练技术。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Domain adaptation is training so a model's ability learned on the source domain (clean catalog images) transfers to the target domain (real user photos).

scenario: 面试要你列出视觉搜索的核心业务指标，每个都能连到一个设计杠杆。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to list visual search's core business metrics, each mapping to a design lever.
q: 以下哪些是视觉搜索的核心业务指标？(多选)
q_en: Which of these are visual search's core business metrics? (multiple)
why: 三个核心业务指标：CTR(结果吸引力/相关性→重排器)、购买转化率(终极营收→意图分类)、空结果率(索引覆盖→ANN 回退层)。GPU 利用率是基建运维指标，不是衡量搜索质量的业务指标。
why_en: The three core business metrics are CTR (attractiveness → re-ranker), purchase conversion (revenue → intent classifier), and zero-result rate (coverage → ANN fallback); GPU utilization is infra ops, not a search-quality business metric.
options: CTR：结果被点击的比例，衡量吸引力/相关性
购买转化率：产生交易的会话比例，终极营收指标
空结果率：无结果越阈值的查询比例，衡量索引覆盖
GPU 利用率：训练集群的算力占用率
options_en: CTR: the fraction of results clicked, measuring attractiveness/relevance.
Purchase conversion rate: the fraction of sessions with a transaction, the ultimate revenue metric.
Zero-result rate: the fraction of queries with no result above threshold, measuring index coverage.
GPU utilization: the compute-usage rate of the training cluster.
optionExplanations: 对；CTR 低(recall 够)指向重排问题，是能连到具体杠杆的业务指标。
对；转化是最终营收信号，低转化(高 CTR)指向意图错配→上游意图分类。
对；空结果率衡量覆盖，高则加 ANN 回退层，是功能可用性的门槛指标。
错；GPU 利用率是基建成本/运维指标，衡量不了搜索结果好不好，不是业务指标。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — low CTR with adequate recall points to a ranking problem, a business metric mapping to a concrete lever.
Correct — conversion is the ultimate revenue signal, and low conversion with high CTR points to intent mismatch and an upstream intent classifier.
Correct — zero-result rate measures coverage, and high values call for ANN fallback tiers, the functionality-gating metric.
Incorrect — GPU utilization is an infra cost/ops metric that cannot measure result quality, not a business metric.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个业务指标异常时对应要动的架构组件(CTR→重排器、转化→意图分类、空结果→回退层)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A design lever is the architectural component to adjust when a business metric is off (CTR→re-ranker, conversion→intent classifier, zero-result→fallback tiers).

scenario: <200ms 预算里，embedding 推理占 10–50ms 通常是最大头，团队想知道该优化哪。
scenario_en: Within the sub-200ms budget, embedding inference at 10–50ms is usually the biggest chunk, and the team wants to know what to optimize.
q: 既然 embedding 推理是主导延迟，优化重点该放哪？
q_en: Since embedding inference dominates latency, where should optimization focus?
why: embedding 推理 10–50ms 是延迟大头，优化点是编码器选择(ResNet≈10ms vs ViT/CLIP≈30–50ms)、批处理与 GPU 加速。ANN 仅 1–10ms，抠它收益小。
why_en: Embedding inference at 10 to 50 milliseconds dominates the budget, so the levers are encoder choice, batching and GPU acceleration, whereas ANN retrieval at 1 to 10 milliseconds is already cheap to squeeze.
options: 优先优化 ANN 检索，把它的 1–10ms 再压掉一半，收益最大
优先优化 embedding 推理：换更快编码器+批处理+GPU 加速
优先优化网络序列化，那才是端到端真正的绝对瓶颈
三个阶段平均用力，不看谁在总延迟里占比更大
options_en: Optimize ANN retrieval first, halving its 1 to 10 milliseconds for the biggest win.
Optimize embedding inference first: a faster encoder plus batching and GPU acceleration.
Optimize network serialization first, which is the true end-to-end bottleneck.
Spread effort evenly across all three stages regardless of their share of total latency.
optionExplanations: 错；ANN 已经只占 1–10ms，把最快的环节再优化对 <200ms 总预算几乎没影响。
对；抓延迟大头，换更快编码器或批处理/GPU 加速能实打实压缩总延迟，是对症优化。
错；网络序列化只占残余预算，不是主导项，先动它是抓错重点。
错；不看占比平均用力效率低，应把力气压在 10–50ms 的 embedding 推理上。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — ANN is already just 1–10ms, so optimizing the fastest stage barely moves the sub-200ms total.
Correct — target the dominator; a faster encoder or batching/GPU acceleration truly shrinks total latency, an on-target optimization.
Wrong — network serialization is only the leftover budget, not the dominator, so starting there misplaces the focus.
Wrong — spreading evenly ignores shares and is inefficient; effort belongs on the 10–50ms embedding inference.

termDefinitions.meaning: 延迟预算里占比最大的阶段(此处 embedding 推理)，优化它对总延迟收益最高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The dominant cost is the stage taking the largest share of the latency budget (here embedding inference), where optimization yields the most.

scenario: 同一道视觉搜索题，L4、L5、Staff+ 候选人在'把哪些决策讲明确'上差别很大。
scenario_en: On the same visual-search question, L4, L5, and Staff+ candidates differ in which decisions they make explicit.
q: L4、L5、Staff+ 在视觉搜索 scoping 上的关键差别是什么？
q_en: What is the key difference among L4, L5, and Staff+ in scoping visual search?
why: L4 认出组件但不分表述、不量化规模；L5 论证表述选择、做指标冲突分析、给数值延迟预算；Staff+ 再上升到平台能力与版本化。
why_en: L4 names the components but never picks a formulation or quantifies scale, L5 justifies the formulation with metric-conflict analysis and a numeric latency budget, and Staff-plus lifts it to platform capability and versioning.
tradeoff: L4(认出组件但不分表述/不量化) vs L5(论证表述+冲突分析+数值预算) vs Staff+(平台化整合)
options: 差别只在于 Staff+ 候选人用了更大更贵的模型，L4 候选人模型太小
L4/L5/Staff+ 给出的答案本质上完全一样，只是表达详略程度不同
L4 认出组件；L5 论证表述与指标冲突；Staff+ 上升到平台层
差别在于 L4 候选人只谈业务、Staff+ 候选人只谈模型，正好互补
options_en: The only difference is that Staff-plus candidates use a bigger, pricier model and L4's model is too small.
L4, L5, and Staff-plus give answers that are essentially identical, differing only in how much detail is spoken.
L4 names components; L5 justifies the formulation and metric conflicts; Staff-plus rises to the platform layer.
The difference is that L4 candidates only discuss business while Staff-plus only discusses models, complementing each other.
optionExplanations: 错；本课强调多数人过度准备模型层，差别不是模型大小或价格而是 scoping 的明确度。
错；不是详略问题，而是是否区分表述、是否做指标冲突分析、是否量化规模的实质差异。
对；层级差别是'把哪些决策讲明确'——表述、指标冲突、规模、平台化，逐级上升。
错；Staff+ 恰恰把业务指标层级与模型/架构整合起来，不是只谈模型，L4 也不止谈业务。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — the lesson stresses most people over-prepare the model layer; the difference is scoping explicitness, not model size or cost.
Wrong — it is not about verbosity but the substantive difference of distinguishing formulations, analyzing metric conflicts, and quantifying scale.
Correct — the level gap is which decisions you make explicit — formulation, metric conflicts, scale, platformization — rising step by step.
Wrong — Staff-plus actually integrates the business-metric hierarchy with model/architecture, not model-only, and L4 doesn't only discuss business either.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把哪些设计决策(表述、指标、规模)显式讲清，是本课认为多数人准备不足的能力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Scoping is making which design decisions (formulation, metrics, scale) explicit, the ability the lesson says most candidates under-prepare.
